newsitem.title: UK: Meyer gains on results, management shift.
newsitem.headline: Meyer gains on results, management shift.

text.p: Shares in Meyer International Plc rose 8-1/2p to 423-1/2p on Wednesday after full-year profits beat analysts' forecasts and the company named a new top management team, analysts said.
The pre-tax figure of 45.4 million stg compared with expectations of 42-43.9 million.

"It was only a couple of million more than expected but it was better and in balance sheet terms it was much better than expected. They ended the year ungeared," said one analyst. He said anlaysts may tweak up forecasts for next year by a few million stg.
"There's nothing in the statement to get excited about but they've resolved the management issue which has seen a lot of indecision over the last few months," he said.
Meyer said its chief executive, John Dobby, would retire at the end of December and would be succeeded by chief operating officer, Alan Peterson.
Chairman Harry Langman will retire in September and be succeeded by non-executive director Tony Palmer.
The retirements follow a number of management changes at Meyer this year, including the previous appointment of John Edwards as finance director.
